༄༅/ /rin chen ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rin chen ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

gang zhig rdul bral khyod sku go 'byed mdog /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi dpal 'chang zhing*// legs spyad brgyad cu'i dbang tshon mdangs bkra ba// thub chen sman gyi sangs rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// lung dang rig smra dpa' bo'i mtshan can dang*// bstan pa'i gsal mdzad yon tan mgon po mchog /zung 'jug don mkhas mnyam nyid badz+ra sogs// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud// sngon chad bod 'dir ha cang ma grags kyang*// dharma swa ma'i legs bshad las byung ba// grang sbyor rin chen ril bu'i gdams pa zhig /'dir spro skal ldan tshogs rnams des pas nyon// sa bdag bcud bsdus tsha bas g.ya' phyi zhing*// k+ṣa ra rnam lngas legs bkru gtso bo'i phyir// za byed khams lnga 'ching byed lcags brgyad kyis// btso zhing dgra sprad sra mkhregs ldan pa dang*// gser dngul zangs lcags a bha ka bsregs thal// lcags mdog gnyis dang badz+ra hi ra dang*// khyung skyugs man shel pad+ma rā ga dang*// in+d+ra nī la nal dang g.yu spos shel// spug dang mu tig dngul dang mu men dang*// byu ru nya phyis sbal rgyab gangs kyi thigs// mañdzi ra dang dkar po chig thub dang*// khab len cong zhi lcags rdo mdung rtse dmar// mtshal dkar ze tshwa 'gron thal bzang po drug /gla rtsi dom mkhris ma gi ta dang ni// sngo leb spu dang ha ri ta ka dang*// dug med gsum dang dpa' bo dkar po dang*// dpa' rgod sug smel glang chen chig thub dang*// las mkhan gser gyi rgyal mtshan khaṇ+ḍa dang*// gang chung g.yu rgyan ma dang be ljang dang*// tsi tra mū la ghid+da dhū pe dang*// mu men ga sha can dang ko tra ba// spang rgyan dkar dang dung gi thag pa can// yungs kar cho lo pad khang khyor ba re// sman mchog sdong po tsan+dan dkar dmar dang*// a ga ru nag shing gsum bar shun dang*// stab seng srad dkar mdongs dang byi thur dang*// sma ra spyi mchan spu dang ka le dza// nywa sha sha chen sha tshil chu tshan gsum// sa bcud rnams ni gzhung sman brgyad cu gsum// kha skong brag khyung pu par spyi spang uta// stag te phur lhog gser tig stong tang dang*// pri shug sbyar te zhib btags pi zhus g.yo// 'dam bur btags la zhag bdun bar du 'thag

/dul tshe sran phos rtsi dril grib mar bskam// rab tu gnas la nyi gnam ma mthong bya// bsten thabs phan yon logs su bkod der ltos// 'bring sbyor 'bigs byed gser dngul zangs dang lcags// a bha g.yu spos byi mu mu sran bla// bong ba dkar dmar sug smel dom gyi rtsi// cu gur li dzā sug ka ko yungs mdongs// lcags rtsi a ru dpa' bo ser po dang*// mchin pa rnams sbyar dril thabs gong bzhin bya// chung sbyor rgyal po dang ni blon po lnga// dmag dpon ser dang 'bangs drug nor legs po// gzi mdangs dmag gis kastu ri mtshon cha thogs// a phub khur te yungs kyi rta la zhon// 'thag thabs grib mar skam thabs gong ltar bya// zhib pa slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag la yod// de min 'di la bya thabs bzo ma mchis// 'ol tshod byas na cis kyang 'di mi 'byung*// phan yon la sogs gang dgos logs su yod// 'di ni ma tshang med bsdus zhib bkod pa// kye ma dharma swa mi gangs kyi ri bo las// 'ongs pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan man ngag chu// kong sman dkon rgyan 'bab stegs yid bzang por// legs bskrun de las yongs rdzogs rgyun bab steng*// bdag blo'i bum bzang yongs su gang ba'i mthus| |sbyor sde mchog 'di phan sems blo yis sbyar// dge bas 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen thob shog /ces pa rin chen grang sbyor ril bu'i sbyor thabs 'di'ang*/ gso rig gi gnas la cung zad goms par bgyis pa'i dge slong dharma kīrtis khrom stod kyi sgar du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu//
